posts.title: The gatekeeper pattern for multi-tenant workloads
posts.description: I wanted tenant applications to use AI inference without giving them unlimited access. A Gatekeeper Worker enforces quotas, and platform-controlled bindings tell it which tenant is calling. No application-managed credentials required.

posts.title: josh-mode: Teaching agents how I like to work
posts.description: Coding agents and the current generation of AI models have changed the way I work. But my preferences and how I solve problems have not changed. I built `josh-mode` to teach agents how I like to work and it has led to better outcomes. In this post, I share my approach and how you can build your own personal working mode.

posts.title: An ode to customizability and TRMNL
posts.description: How we replaced an over-worked kitchen whiteboard with a customizable TRMNL display powered by Apple calendars, Liquid templates, and a little help from GPT.
